links.title: Note links
links.guide: In note A, type [[ and choose note B. After saving, A lists B under Outgoing and B lists A under Backlinks. Click a list entry to navigate; a link in both notes is unnecessary.
links.typingHint: Click links and reference cards directly in Notes. The typewriter preserves plain text editing: Ctrl-click (Command-click on Mac) a link, or use the Note links panel.
links.anchorHint: Supports [[Note title#Heading|Display name]]. Missing or ambiguous targets appear under Unresolved; creating the target resolves its links.
links.resolveError: The link target is missing or ambiguous. Check unresolved links or duplicate titles.

saveError: Note could not be saved or changed elsewhere. Your draft is preserved; retry or merge the latest version.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.hint: These bindings apply inside the app. System clipboard hotkeys are managed in Clipboard settings.
shortcuts.migrated: Command palette uses Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+P; Typewriter Press now uses Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+P.
shortcuts.reserved: This key is reserved for terminal controls, text editing or Office printing. Choose another binding.

plugins.title: Plugin management
plugins.author: Author
plugins.defaultPermissions: Obsidian package: controlled note access; no Node or arbitrary files
plugins.compatibilityHint: Compatibility is specific to plugin version, platform and editor mode. Downloading does not verify all APIs.
plugins.marketHint: Community catalog from Obsidian. Enable separately after installation; unsupported APIs report a specific reason.
plugins.example: Native example: count note text, insert timestamps, and save a writing goal.
plugins.downloadConfirm: Download and install {name}? It will be disabled initially.
plugins.officialSample: Original official 1.0.0 release. main.js, manifest.json and styles.css are unmodified. Tests lifecycle, commands, modals and settings.
plugins.markdownHint: From a note or Typewriter, find the compatible Markdown editor in the command palette. CodeMirror extensions run in that mode.
